subject: CS353
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English videos and 1 Arabic video. The English coverage is excellent, with highly relevant and popular videos for all topics. Arabic coverage is sparse; a suitable video was found only for the Backtracking topic. For the other four topics, Arabic candidates either failed the relevance gate by teaching the wrong concept/problem, or no candidates were available at all.

coverage.note: All candidates either teach a different technique (Dynamic Programming, Greedy) or apply Branch and Bound to a different problem, failing the relevance gate.
All candidates teach numerical approximation from mathematics/calculus, not the computer science concept of approximation algorithms for NP-hard problems, failing the relevance gate.
No candidates teach the specific MST-based 2-approximation algorithm; they are either general introductions to TSP or cover other methods (e.g., genetic algorithms), failing the relevance gate.
No Arabic-language candidates were found for this topic.
